authorization: Operationalizes the deterministic-primary / machine-secondary route the user already authorized in E4_1_EVALUATION_AMENDMENT_001, given the engineering evidence in E4_SCORER_FREEZE_READINESS: Qwen-Max stable (15/15, parse 1.0), GLM-4-flash failures are multi-candidate-induced and fixable via atomic scoring, Doubao-seed-2.1-turbo persistently times out at 90s. No new judge introduced. No human scoring introduced.
scope: E4 evaluation route secondary metric and machine-judge gate structure only. Collection engineering remains CLOSED. Does not retroactively alter C9.2 historical artifacts (C9_2_QUALITY_EVALUATION_PROTOCOL.json, C9_2_JUDGE_PROVIDER_AMENDMENT_003.json remain the frozen record of the C9 route).

supersedes.E4_1_EVALUATION_AMENDMENT_001.json: Replaces the secondary_metric definition ('median of three 0-4 scores divided by 4') and the machine_gates clause ('Existing Amendment-003 ... thresholds unchanged; no replacement by a two-family-only consensus') FOR THE E4 ROUTE ONLY. All other Amendment-001 clauses retained.
supersedes.C9_2_JUDGE_PROVIDER_AMENDMENT_003.json: Replaces the formal_consensus_if_calibration_passes ('median of three integer 0-4 scores') and the implicit three-judge consensus requirement FOR THE E4 ROUTE ONLY. Amendment-003 remains the frozen rule for the C9 route.

primary_metric: Unchanged from Amendment-001: unit-aware deterministic final N4 delivered correctness on the 17 predeclared numeric-reference-eligible tasks only. Not whole-E4 semantic quality. Tolerance unchanged: max(1e-6, 1e-4*abs(reference)) in reference units; percent/ratio conversion requires explicit per-task unit contract (delivered by B1).

secondary_metric.name: machine_judged_final_answer_quality
secondary_metric.limitation_label: machine-judged semantic quality, without human validation
secondary_metric.frozen_label_definition: For each open-task candidate, the frozen machine semantic quality endpoint is the qwen-max integer 0-4 score divided by 4. qwen-max is the single primary judge; its score is NOT median-averaged with GLM or Doubao.
secondary_metric.glm_role: GLM-4-flash is EITHER (a) a valid independent sensitivity judge on a COMPLETE or near-complete label set after passing its frozen atomic-calibration gate, OR (b) ENGINEERING_UNAVAILABLE. There is no third state. GLM is reported INDEPENDENTLY as sensitivity / cross-check, never averaged into the primary endpoint. Partial-subset GLM scoring ('use where it succeeded') is FORBIDDEN as formal sensitivity evidence because it introduces non-random missingness bias.
secondary_metric.glm_gate_outcome: If GLM fails the frozen atomic calibration gate it is marked ENGINEERING_UNAVAILABLE and repair stops; it is not kept retrying and is not used as a secondary. If it passes, the GLM sensitivity arm is reported on the complete (or near-complete, with explicit missingness disclosure) labeled population.
secondary_metric.doubao_role: doubao-seed-2.1-turbo is ENGINEERING_UNAVAILABLE (TimeoutError at 90s; observed 90067ms). It is not used as a primary or secondary judge for the E4 route. It is retained ONLY as the Doubao-only sensitivity arm where its labels exist; missing Doubao labels block only that sensitivity arm, never the primary endpoint.
secondary_metric.raw_score_retention: Every raw judge response and every parsed integer score is preserved. No score imputation. No threshold relaxation. No replacement of a missing judge by a consensus of the remaining two.
secondary_metric.applies_to: All 23 open_semantic tasks (the 23 = 18 no-reference + 5 reference-but-non-numeric) identified outcome-blind in E4_1_DETERMINISTIC_COVERAGE_AUDIT.json. Only the 160 final N4 trajectory outcomes (40 tasks x 4 trajectories) are scored; N1-N3 inherit RTG_t = Q_final per E4_1_STATE_OBSERVABILITY_PROTOCOL.json.

machine_gates.note: Replaces the three-judge consensus gate with per-judge gates. No threshold value is relaxed relative to Amendment-003; the structure changes from consensus-of-three to primary-plus-independent-secondary because two of three judges cannot meet the parse gate.

glm-4-flash.agreement_not_worse_than: frozen Amendment-003 calibration requirement (pairwise within-one >= 0.80, mae <= 0.75) on the qwen/glm common population
glm-4-flash.condition: Atomic one-answer-per-call prompting only; rubric, 0-4 scale, temperature 0, and prompt SEMANTICS unchanged; only serialization/granularity changes from multi-candidate to one-candidate-per-call. Reuse parse_scores with labels=[single_label]; parser unchanged.
glm-4-flash.test_scope: The 5 previously failed calibration groups only.
glm-4-flash.root_cause_of_multicandidate_failure: partial-label coverage and self-atomized multi-block output under multi-candidate prompting
glm-4-flash.on_fail: GLM = ENGINEERING_UNAVAILABLE; stop repair; do not retry.

doubao-seed-2.1-turbo.evidence: TimeoutError at 90s, observed 90067ms; 2 unresolved in closure, 4 historical.

machine_gates.agreement_gate_on_common_population: Retain Amendment-001 pairwise metrics (within-one, mae, spearman) as DIAGNOSTIC, reported on the qwen/glm common population; not a blocking consensus gate for the E4 route.

machine_sensitivity.purpose: Probe judge bias and family confounding directly. These are the judge-bias checks; state shuffling is NOT a judge-bias check (see mechanism_clause below).
outputs: qwen-vs-glm agreement on common population: exact, within-one, mae, spearman, quadratic-weighted-kappa
leave-one-judge-out: endpoint-excluding-GLM (i.e., qwen-primary alone, already the primary) and glm-only sensitivity
candidate-family score-deviation audit (qwen-plus/qwen-turbo and glm-5.2 family overlap disclosure retained from Amendment-003)

deterministic_secondary_cross_check.note: On the 17 deterministic-eligible tasks, the deterministic score (B1+B2) and the qwen-max machine score are both computed and reported independently. Disagreement is diagnostic; the deterministic endpoint is primary on those tasks, the qwen score is a cross-check and a bridge to the 23 open tasks.

mechanism_clause.state_shuffling: Observability mechanism test only: checks whether real runtime state carries information beyond request+node. It is NOT a check on qwen-max length/format/style preference and does NOT substitute for human validity.
mechanism_clause.judge_bias_checks: Qwen-Max length/format/style bias is checked via (a) agreement with the deterministic subset on the 17 deterministic-eligible tasks, (b) qwen-vs-glm agreement and leave-one-judge-out sensitivity above, (c) candidate-family score-deviation audit. These are reported regardless of the GO/STOP result.

depth_analysis_clause.rtg_scope: RTG_t = Q_final(N4) for all of N1-N4. For the paper question 'how much value does state at different depths bring to the final workflow return', every node uses the same-trajectory final RTG. Local per-node N1/N2/N3 semantic labels are added ONLY if a local-mechanism question ('why does N2 extract better, why does N3 reason better') is asked. Not added in this freeze.

judge_format_repair.allowed: Unchanged from Amendment-001: only deterministic syntax normalization with exact label coverage and unchanged integer scores/reasons; raw response preserved.
judge_format_repair.atomic_scoring_implementation: To be added by B4: a single-candidate variant of prompt_for plus an aggregation loop calling parse_scores with a single-element labels list. Parser unchanged.
judge_format_repair.tests: 9 existing tests pass; atomic path covered by test_wrapped_array_and_literal_newlines (labels=['A']).

workflow_validity_clause.delivered_quality: Q_delivered = Q_final * I(valid delivery). The mechanical valid-delivery rule is finalized from phase_e4_0/interfaces.py frozen fields by B5 before labels. Provider failure -> delivered quality 0, semantic correctness unavailable (unchanged).

pre_freeze_conditions.B1: Freeze per-task unit/scale/multiple-valid-representation contracts for the 17 deterministic-eligible tasks (E4_1_NUMERIC_UNIT_CONTRACT_PENDING.json -> frozen).
pre_freeze_conditions.B2: Implement reference-independent final-answer extractor for the deterministic layer with synthetic tests before candidate output access.
pre_freeze_conditions.B4: Implement GLM atomic-scoring call loop and verify parse_success >= 0.95 on the 5 previously failed calibration groups.
pre_freeze_conditions.B5: Finalize mechanical workflow-validity rule for Q_delivered from interfaces.py.

forbidden: score imputation for a missing or unavailable judge
threshold relaxation to make a failing judge pass
median or mean averaging of qwen-max with GLM/Doubao as the endpoint
post-result decision to average qwen-max with GLM based on StateAware gains or any downstream outcome
using GLM only on its successful subset as formal sensitivity evidence (non-random missingness bias)
partial 'use-where-available' GLM scoring; GLM is either complete/near-complete sensitivity or ENGINEERING_UNAVAILABLE
using GLM as primary while Qwen-Max is available
treating state shuffling as proof of judge validity or absence of judge bias
scanning candidate answers for a gold-matching number (deterministic extractor must be reference-independent)
changing rubric, 0-4 scale, temperature, or prompt semantics for the atomic GLM path (only serialization/granularity may change)
continuing to retry GLM repair after a frozen-gate failure
semantic labels before B1, B2, B4, B5 close
router training or DAG execution before labels and the GO gate

completion_gate.rule: All of the following must hold before any formal E4 semantic outcome is accessed. Only then is the final scorer artifact frozen and formal E4 scoring permitted to begin.
conditions: GLM status resolved to SECONDARY_READY or ENGINEERING_UNAVAILABLE (B4)
completion_gate.on_pass: freeze final scorer artifact; formal E4 scoring may begin on the 160 final N4 outcomes. Do NOT yet train RequestOnly/StateAware.

only_these_fields_reported: formal E4 outcome accessed? (false until completion gate passes)
